scope: Internal native attack-kind and selected-weapon evidence; no game binaries or binary dumps are included.

handoff.nativeExecutableHashNote: No current native executable hash was provided by the research handoff.

findings.abi: void (void *player, unsigned char attack_variant); a0 is the playable task; a1 is a byte-sized native variant, not the selected weapon. The prologue stores a1 to its caller home, and lbu at stack offset 0x1EF selects its low byte. No stack-passed arguments; callers ignore the return and no authored return value is present.
findings.variantBounds: Character-specific tables contain 20 entries (0..0x13), no bounds check. Hammer setup contexts pass 0x0F,0x12,0x13.
findings.sideEffects: Per-variant setup calls func_801DD830_599740 and conditionally requests native effect selector 0x21.

corroboration.finding: Weapon-cycle 1-to-2 checks save+0xB4+4*character; Ebisumaru index1 selects documented Meat Hammer acquisition word save+0xB8.
Ebisumaru selected-weapon2 dispatches actions0x84/0x8A/0x8B; selected-weapon3 dispatches camera actions0x8C/0x8D.

limitations: No live gameplay or two-client run was performed.
The native selection table is not evidence that an outgoing sphere is currently active. Native collision descriptor/state and real playable ownership remain required.
Native executable hash was unavailable; symbol-table hashes and exact Ghidra program identity record the available reproducibility evidence.
